name: SVC_STANDARD_TEXT_INT
description: This table is created in top of view (SVC_STANDARD_TEXT_VL). The view build on top of SVC_STANDARD_TEXT_B and SVC_STANDARD_TEXT_TL tables.

columns.name: STD_TXT_ID
columns.description: This is resolved during the enrichment process.

columns.name: STD_TXT_UNIQUE_NUMBER
columns.description: Std_txt_unique_number. This is a public surrogate key which is required in the base table.

columns.name: STD_TXT_NUMBER
columns.description: Std_txt_number. This is a public surrogate key.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: STDTXT_NAME
columns.description: Short descriptive name for the Standard Text. This is searchable through the UI and indexed.

columns.name: TEXT
columns.description: Language dependent, translatable standard text.

columns.name: HTML_FLAG
columns.description: Y/N flag to indicate if the standard text is rich text or plain text. Default is N.

columns.name: FOLDER_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to assign the Standard Text to a folder.

columns.name: FOLDER_NUMBER
columns.description: Folder_number.  This is a public surrogate key.

columns.name: SCOPE
columns.description: Global, User, Role If the scope is User then the USER_ID must contain the FK value.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This must contain the FK value when scope is set to User.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Enable or Disable the Standard Text. This will allow control if the Standard Text can be used by the users. Default is Y

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start Date as of when the text can be used by the users. Default is sysdate.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Final date when the text can be used by the users.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Internal action code will be populated internally by framework based on ourcome of match step.

columns.name: INTERNAL_OVN
columns.description: The Object Version Number of the record begin updated. Used for Optimistic Locking as part of Incremental Update.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: This column is required by import wizard to relate record in the interface table to the file row.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: This is an optional column and would be useful if consumers want any error message as the first error.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: This column indicates import wizard if the import to base table was successful or Erorred out.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: This column is required to track multi csv import of standard text folder objects

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: For each run of the job, import wizard generates a new batch id and this batch id will be used uniquely.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Used to link this record with the error record.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Additional column to resolve USER_PARTY_ID using alternate key PARTY_NUMBER.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ORIG_SYS
columns.description: Additional column to resolve USER_PARTY_ID using original system reference.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ORIG_SYS_REF
columns.description: Additional column to resolve USER_PARTY_ID using original system reference.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Action code will be used to determine what operation should be done: insert,update,delete.

columns.name: LANGUAGE
columns.description: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: DOMAIN
columns.description: Domain or Category for the SmartText.

columns.name: STRIPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the stripe code, such as CRM, HCM, or PRM.

columns.name: OBJECT
columns.description: This is the primary object the SmartText is used for.

columns.name: BU_ORG_ID
columns.description: Stores the Business Unit Org Id of the SmartText.
